flags.why: In Southern Vietnamese, chỏ commonly means the elbow itself.
Tang chứng specifically means physical evidence of an offence, rather than evidence or proof generally.
A common meaning is to win money through gambling or a wager.
flags.fix: verb | to win money (in gambling or a wager)

flags.why: This slang expression for masturbation is vulgar and needs a warning beyond the slang tag.
The example needs như vũ bão; phát triển vũ bão is not natural Vietnamese.
flags.fix: Công nghệ đang phát triển như vũ bão. = Technology is developing at breakneck speed.
